hypothesis: Contracts that have only recently completed their first 180 days retain more speculative attention and less settled ownership than older contracts, so an equal-weight long-oldest/short-youngest age-cohort spread should earn a positive return as that premium decays.
falsifier: Reject if the old-minus-young spread is not repeatable across independent listing vintages and chronological folds, if either side has persistently non-positive gross contribution, or if the result depends on a single bull, bear, or chop regime.
